value.rationale: For the canonical smallest projective plane matroid, the theorem determines the complete 168-element automorphism action and interprets it in terms of two naturally occurring, nonisomorphic topological/group-theoretic representations. The full-group decomposition, the absence of fixed classes, and its bridge to Heawood homology are not consequences of nonequivariant 13 and 6 Betti numbers or a Singer subgroup restriction.
